source: Municipality of Evora athletics race regulation 2022 + Portuguese government cultural heritage inventory for Braga, crosschecked with Braga municipality facility register (21 October 2026); Portuguese Athletics Federation competition technical location map (3 May 2025); OpenStreetMap site boundary way 1266229401/mapcarta site reference inspected 27 October 2026
notes: CAOP verifies municipality only. Evora GPS is a 2022 municipal race/track waypoint, not a confirmed entrance. Braga GPS is the listed stadium site, not a dedicated athletics-track point. Neither is an approved production venue GPS. FPA 2025 map pin is visually on the FOOTBALL PITCH inside the stadium, not the athletics track or an entrance; close agreement between venue site waypoints does not verify exact track GPS. Évora has an existing live public venue (ID 272); original name-only/city-only API searches containing uppercase É incorrectly return no matches, despite district-scoped pagination returning ID 272. Official 2022 athletics event waypoint differs by ~144m from OSM named complex polygon centre. These are two different point TYPES and must not be averaged or used to approve GPS automatically.
